name: Velar Imperium
status_note: Status 'inactive' = no longer a functioning unified polity (controlled-vocabulary value). No longer exists as the unified galactic empire it once was. It is a failed/fractured state: its former core worlds were absorbed into the Galactic Union, and what remains persists only as post-imperial remnant territory held by splinter factions and remnant warlords.
government: A once-unified galactic empire that failed and fractured. No single authority commands it; what survives is contested among competing remnant factions: Imperial Loyalists (restorationists), Republican Reformists (constitutional reformers), and Outer Colony Warlords (frontier remnant strongmen). It is no longer a functioning empire — it is a post-imperial remnant.

successor_and_remnant_disposition.absorbed_into_galactic_union: A portion of the former Velar core was absorbed into the Galactic Union and now constitutes important Union core systems. Attested: Vel-Surak — a former Velar core world — is now bound to galactic_union and located in the Inner Mid-Disk Core Zone (loc_zone_inner_mid_disk_core).
successor_and_remnant_disposition.surviving_remnant: The remaining Imperium territory is the Velar Crescent (loc_zone_velar_crescent), the 'Post-Imperial Fault Line': ruin worlds (loc_velar_ruin_worlds), border worlds (loc_vel_border_01, loc_vel_core_01), and outer colony nodes (loc_velar_outer_colony_nodes) — the last held by the remnant Outer Colony Warlords.
successor_and_remnant_disposition.people_split: The Velari are split across both successors: species_velari.member_polities = [velar_imperium, galactic_union]. Membership in the Union does not extinguish Velari identity, and the remnant Imperium does not encompass the whole people.
successor_and_remnant_disposition.evidence: Derived from committed location records (loc_vel_surak → galactic_union / Inner Mid-Disk Core; the Crescent-bound Velar worlds → velar_imperium) and species_velari member_polities. Not invented.

traits: Deeply divided, vulnerable to external manipulation

notes: The Velar Imperium is a FAILED/FRACTURED former galactic empire — the origin polity of the Velari people — that no longer exists as the unified great power it once was. Its former core worlds were absorbed into the Galactic Union (e.g. Vel-Surak, now a Union core system in the Inner Mid-Disk Core Zone), while its surviving remnant is confined to the Velar Crescent (Post-Imperial Fault Line) and held by splinter factions and remnant warlords (Outer Colony Warlords). It was referenced across canon (species_velari origin_polity_id + member_polity, three internal-faction org records, the Union-Imperium border conflict, the virex_talvaren capsule, and multiple Velar location records) but had no parent entity record; this record closes that dangling canonical referent. Every attribute is recovered from the cited sources and cross-linked location/species records — not invented.

naming_exemption.reason: Polity name "Velar Imperium" preserved verbatim from GUMAS_Factions.json and the canonical timeline (Velar-Harkon Wars); the referent "velar_imperium" is already in canonical use across multiple committed records.

peoplehood_note: A STATE (a former imperial government, now fragmented), not the Velari people themselves. The Velari also hold membership in the Galactic Union (per species_velari.member_polities); the Imperium does not encompass the whole Velari people.
identity_model_note: Polity = a state / political entity, an orthogonal dimension from species (people), culture, and region. A polity does not describe a whole people.
certainty_basis: Existence is CANON (referenced by CANON species/location records and the timeline-attested Velar-Harkon Wars); attributes are recovered-source from the cited archive and cross-linked to existing internal-faction records. No invention.
